sources.locator: "Algerian War", revision 1374452636, § After the Philippeville massacre

explanation: The Algerian war’s article gives France’s reading of Nasser — that Cairo armed the FLN — as one of the things that put France into Suez. The article reads: "This attitude was a factor in persuading France to participate in the November 1956 attempt to seize the Suez Canal during the Suez Crisis."
